subject: PO identifier whitelist, invoice bucketing and discount eligibility
messages:
From: Emily Ross <procurement@medsolv.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: PO field requirements for Redwood + discount slab question

Hi Priyom,

Quick procurement question as we start the purchase order process for the Redwood Dedicated commitment (RD-2026-1442). Our AP team follows strict PO metadata rules and we want to make sure the invoicing will map cleanly to our ERP. Two asks:  

1) Can you confirm the exact PO identifier(s) Redwood must receive on invoices so our system can auto-accept them? We have a long list of acceptable PO headers (PO_NUMBER, PO_REF, CONTRACT_ID) and want to whitelist the right field to avoid manual holds.

2) Discount eligibility: the SOW references a volume discount that activates when monthly usage > 2M tokens. Will monthly invoice bucketing (we sometimes backfill with weekly invoices that roll into a monthly statement) still allow MedSolv to get the discount, or do you require a single consolidated invoice for the month?

If helpful, I can attach our AP field spec and a sample EDI/CSV invoice. We want to avoid rejections and payment delays during the first quarter.

Thanks,
Emily Ross
Senior Procurement Manager
MedSolv Health
(Attachment: medsolv-ap-field-spec.csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <procurement@medsolv.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements for Redwood + discount slab question

Hi Emily — thanks for flagging these up early. Short answers up front: 1) We can accept any of the PO headers you listed, but require a single canonical PO identifier to be present on every invoice line so it maps to your PO in the ERP. 2) Discount eligibility is applied to recognized monthly usage per billing account; weekly invoices that roll up to the month are fine as long as the month-level statement identifies the total usage and references the canonical PO ID.

A few practical requirements to avoid manual rework (see attached stubs I’m sending):
- PO whitelist: Redwood requires a PO_ID or PO_NUMBER field on the invoice header and repeated on each line item for automated processing.
- Invoice bucketing: we support multiple invoice deliveries (weekly/bi-weekly) but the final monthly statement must include a summary line that aggregates token usage and references the PO. That aggregated monthly summary is what triggers the discount slab calculation.
- Net terms: standard net30 on hosted invoices; for Dedicated we can accommodate net45/60 on signed SOWs but that affects early-pay discount eligibility.
- Remittance: include remittance_account_id (we provide our AP remittance mapping in an attachment).

I’m attaching a quick CSV whitelist and a sample invoice template for your AP team to validate against your ERP. I’ve looped in Vanessa (billing ops) and Vivek (contracts/legal) to confirm any constraints on the legal side.

Next steps: if you can send the AP field spec (or sample CSV), Vanessa will validate and confirm mapping within 48 hours. If there are any required PO header names we don’t accept today, we’ll add them to our ingestion rules.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-po-whitelist.csv, sample_invoice_template.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <procurement@medsolv.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements for Redwood + discount slab question

Emily — quick note from billing ops: we tested the sample CSV fields you sent internally and have two practical asks to prevent AP holds:  

- Please ensure the PO identifier is present in the invoice file name and in the header field (PO_NUMBER or PO_ID). Example file name we accept: MEDSOLV_PO_123456_invoice_20261130.csv.
- For weekly invoices that roll up to a monthly statement, include a final consolidated PDF monthly statement ("Monthly Statement - Nov 2026") that references the weekly invoices and shows the total token usage and total due. That consolidated PDF is what our finance workflow uses to apply the discount slab.

Also, on discount calculation: we apply the agreed slab to the monthly aggregated usage after taxes and after any pre-approved credits; partial prepayments are applied as prepaid credits and do not change the slab calculation (they just reduce the payable balance). If MedSolv needs invoices tagged to separate cost centers, include the BU_CODE on each line item or we will split the invoice into ledger-backed lines and it can delay auto-apply.

If you can confirm you will provide the consolidated monthly statement (PDF) and include PO_ID on every invoice line, we will enable automated acceptance in our ingestion pipeline.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: discount_slabs.xlsx)

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO field requirements for Redwood + discount slab question

Thanks — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups from AP/Finance:  

1) Net terms: MedSolv prefers net45 for enterprise commitments. Is Redwood willing to approve net45 for RD-2026-1442 if we provide a blanket PO for Q1 and enroll in ACH/auto-apply?
2) Prepayment: we sometimes do 10% prepay at rollout for critical vendor onboarding. Would a 10% prepayment alter when a monthly usage slab is applied (i.e., do you apply slabs against gross usage or against net due after prepay)?

Also attaching our canonical AP field spec and a sample of the filename conventions we use.

Emily Ross
Senior Procurement Manager
MedSolv Health
